description:
Playbooks tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_playbooks: List Draftless playbooks — named, ready-made workflows (Ad Strategist, Hook Multiplier, Effect Recreate…) grouped into bundles.
- get_playbook: Show what one playbook does, what it needs from the caller, and the steps it will run.
- plan_playbook: Return a costed plan for a playbook: every step, the model behind it and the exact credit cost.
- execute_playbook: Run a playbook end to end as the signed-in user.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: playbooks
title: Playbooks
